_readme: Real AOBS broadcast captures live in /public/media/broadcast/ and are listed here. Add more 16:9 frames (no faces) and they appear on the programme monitor, multiview, gallery and case studies. Source files: /assets/portfolio/ (see docs/content-inventory.md).
